text:
mae: Heads up — just got paged: EU control-plane spike. Deploybot auto-paused the canary rollout for orca-1.12.3. Holding the release window until we triage.

deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Deploy paused for release=orca-1.12.3 canary_group=eu-west — reason: control-plane RPC errors > 5% over 2m. action_required: triage + ops decision.

sam: looking into metrics now (datadog). moving to #incidents-eu for signal aggregation.

lucy: seeing kube-apiserver 503s correlated with node NotReady events. autoscaler flapped twice. kv-store eviction spike at 18:42 UTC.

mae: can we pin traffic to last-known-good v1.12.2 for eu-west as a fallback? prefer pin + hold rather than full rollback unless canary fails after short window.

sre-lead: +1 pin to v1.12.2 for safety. @deploybot: keep slot reserved for eu-west; do not advance other zones.

deploybot: [COMMAND] pin_release release=orca target_version=1.12.2 scope=eu-west — OK (pinned by sre-lead)

charlie: ops rec: reschedule remaining rollouts to next change window (2026-03-22 02:00 UTC) unless control-plane stable by 01:30 UTC. If stable, resume with a small 5% golden canary and monitor for 10m.

mae: agreed. stabilization condition: error-rate < 1% and no further node flaps for 15m. We'll leave a note in release notes either way.

sam: quick update: error-rate trending down to ~1.8% but kv-store eviction count still elevated.

mae: decision: hold until 01:30 UTC; if metrics satisfy criteria then resume a 5% canary, otherwise move to scheduled window at 02:00 UTC. Documenting decision here.

deploybot: [SCHEDULE] resume_check at=1740001800 (01:30 UTC) — will run healthcheck (api-latency, error-rate, node-ready) and post summary.

mae: adding release note: "Canary paused due to EU control-plane instability. Target resume/check: 2026-03-22 01:30 UTC. If unstable, rollout rescheduled to 02:00 UTC change window."

lucy: filed INC-3421 linking Datadog graphs, kube-events, and node traces. Added initial RCA notes: suspected autoscaler config + recent kernel bump on host pool.

sam: ops playbook quick command if we want a manual resume after verifying metrics:

```
deploybot resume --release orca-1.12.3 --zone eu-west --canary 5
```

mae: bookmarking that. If we do manual resume, we'll monitor token-level latency and tracing for regressed tail.

oncall-bot: reminder — oncall rotation handoff at 02:00 UTC. Keep incident updates in #incidents-eu and @oncall until resolved.

mae: thanks everyone. I'll post the final decision after the resume_check. :thumbsup:
